# montecarlo_presto_credentials (Data Source)

Presto credentials are the login Monte Carlo stores for a Presto or Trino cluster. A Data Lake warehouse's query connection uses them. The password is never returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials_id` (String) Id of the credentials, as returned when they are created or listed.

### Read-Only

- `catalog` (String) Catalog Monte Carlo queries. Null unless set.
- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `host` (String) Hostname of the Presto or Trino coordinator.
- `http_scheme` (String) Whether to reach the coordinator over `http` or `https`. Null means `http`.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `metadata_catalog_id` (String) Name of the catalog in the metadata store. Null means it is `catalog`.
- `port` (Number) Port the coordinator listens on.
- `schema` (String) Schema Monte Carlo queries by default. Null unless set.
- `ssl_skip_verification` (Boolean) Connect over TLS without checking the server's certificate.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
- `user` (String) User Monte Carlo signs in as.
